title: CS-301: Computer Architecture & Network Security Final Exam
description: Comprehensive university examination covering pipelining, memory hierarchy, cryptography, and network defense.

questions.prompt: Which hazard in pipelined processors occurs when an instruction depends on the result of a previous instruction that is still in progress?
In modern virtual memory systems, what is the primary role of the Translation Lookaside Buffer (TLB)?
options: To cache page table entries and accelerate virtual-to-physical address translation
To encrypt disk blocks when swapping memory pages
To balance network traffic between CPU cores
To compress swap memory on low-RAM devices
questions.correctAnswer: To cache page table entries and accelerate virtual-to-physical address translation

questions.prompt: Which symmetric encryption mode provides both confidentiality and data integrity authentication in a single algorithm?
What TCP flag combination is sent by a client to initiate the standard 3-way handshake with a server?
Which of the following cache replacement policies discards the item that has not been accessed for the longest period of time?
Briefly define Amdahl's Law and state why infinite processor parallelization does not yield infinite speedup.
questions.correctAnswer: Amdahl's law states that overall speedup is limited by the serial/sequential fraction of the workload.

questions.prompt: Explain the mechanism of a Return-Oriented Programming (ROP) attack. Describe how Data Execution Prevention (DEP / NX bit) attempted to solve buffer overflows and how ROP circumvents DEP by chaining gadgets.
questions.correctAnswer: Subjective response evaluated by instructor rubric.
